# Baidu
> Baidu is a Chinese technology platform offering search, AI cloud services, developer platforms, maps, encyclopedia, and consumer internet products.

Baidu operates a broad ecosystem spanning web search, AI foundation models, cloud computing, autonomous driving, developer tooling, knowledge products, and mobile apps. This index prioritizes official documentation, developer resources, product portals, and major service entry points across Baidu’s domains.

## Core Platform
- [Baidu Home](https://www.baidu.com/): Main portal for Baidu search and access to core products and services.
- [Baidu Search](https://www.baidu.com/): Web search engine for websites, news, images, video, and more.
- [Baidu About](https://home.baidu.com/): Corporate portal with company information, business lines, and official announcements.
- [Baidu Products](https://home.baidu.com/home/index/products): Directory of Baidu’s major consumer, enterprise, and AI products.
- [Baidu Open Platform](https://open.baidu.com/): Entry point for Baidu open services, integrations, and platform capabilities.

## AI Cloud
- [Baidu AI Cloud](https://cloud.baidu.com/): Official portal for Baidu cloud infrastructure, AI services, and enterprise solutions.
- [AI Cloud Documentation](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/): Product documentation for cloud services, deployment, and operations.
- [AI Cloud API Center](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/index.html): Central index for cloud product documentation and API references.
- [Baidu Intelligent Cloud Console](https://console.bce.baidu.com/): Management console for Baidu Cloud resources and account services.
- [Baidu Cloud Pricing](https://cloud.baidu.com/pricing/index.html): Pricing information for compute, storage, networking, and AI products.
- [Baidu Cloud Marketplace](https://marketplace.bce.baidu.com/): Marketplace for software, services, and partner offerings on Baidu Cloud.

## AI Developer Platform
- [Baidu AI Open Platform](https://ai.baidu.com/): Developer platform for Baidu AI capabilities, models, and industry solutions.
- [AI Open Platform Docs](https://ai.baidu.com/ai-doc/): Documentation for speech, vision, NLP, OCR, and other AI APIs.
- [AI Open Platform Console](https://console.bce.baidu.com/ai/): Console for managing AI applications, credentials, and service usage.
- [Baidu PaddlePaddle](https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/): Open-source deep learning framework and ecosystem led by Baidu.
- [PaddlePaddle Documentation](https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/documentation/docs/): Framework guides, API references, tutorials, and deployment documentation.
- [PaddleHub](https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/hub): Pretrained model and toolkit hub for PaddlePaddle developers.

## ERNIE and Foundation Models
- [ERNIE Bot](https://yiyan.baidu.com/): Baidu’s generative AI assistant and entry point for ERNIE model experiences.
- [Wenxin Workshop](https://wenxin.baidu.com/): Platform for building applications with Baidu foundation models and AI tooling.
- [Qianfan Platform](https://cloud.baidu.com/product/wenxinworkshop): Enterprise model platform for foundation model development and deployment.
- [Qianfan Documentation](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/WENXINWORKSHOP/index.html): Documentation for model APIs, prompt engineering, and application integration.
- [ModelBuilder](https://cloud.baidu.com/product/modelbuilder): Tools for model customization, fine-tuning, and enterprise AI workflows.

## Maps and Location Services
- [Baidu Maps](https://map.baidu.com/): Web mapping service for navigation, places, traffic, and local discovery.
- [Baidu Maps Open Platform](https://lbsyun.baidu.com/): Developer platform for maps, geocoding, routing, and location APIs.
- [Maps API Documentation](https://lbsyun.baidu.com/index.php?title=jspopular): JavaScript API documentation for embedding and customizing Baidu Maps.
- [Web Service API Docs](https://lbsyun.baidu.com/index.php?title=webapi): HTTP API docs for geocoding, routing, and place search.
- [Android SDK Docs](https://lbsyun.baidu.com/index.php?title=androidsdk): Android SDK documentation for Baidu Maps and location services.
- [iOS SDK Docs](https://lbsyun.baidu.com/index.php?title=iossdk): iOS SDK documentation for Baidu Maps and location services.

## Apollo and Autonomous Driving
- [Apollo Platform](https://apollo.auto/): Baidu’s autonomous driving and intelligent mobility platform.
- [Apollo Documentation](https://apollo.baidu.com/docs/apollo/latest/index.html): Technical documentation for Apollo autonomous driving software and modules.
- [Apollo GitHub](https://github.com/ApolloAuto/apollo): Open-source repository for the Apollo autonomous driving platform.
- [Apollo Developer Center](https://apollo.baidu.com/community): Community and developer resources for Apollo contributors and users.
- [Apollo Open Platform](https://apollo.auto/platform): Overview of Apollo platform capabilities and ecosystem offerings.

## Mobile Ecosystem
- [Baidu App](https://mo.baidu.com/): Official portal for Baidu’s flagship mobile application.
- [Baidu Netdisk](https://pan.baidu.com/): Cloud storage and file sharing service for personal and enterprise use.
- [Baidu Tieba](https://tieba.baidu.com/): Community forum platform organized around topics and interest groups.
- [Baidu Zhidao](https://zhidao.baidu.com/): Question-and-answer knowledge platform for user-generated answers.
- [Baidu Baike](https://baike.baidu.com/): Online encyclopedia with structured entries across many subjects.
- [Baidu Wenku](https://wenku.baidu.com/): Document sharing and reading platform for educational and professional materials.

## Webmaster and Marketing Tools
- [Baidu Search Resource Platform](https://ziyuan.baidu.com/): Webmaster platform for site indexing, SEO tools, and search diagnostics.
- [Search Resource Help Center](https://ziyuan.baidu.com/college/index): Guides and help articles for Baidu search optimization and site management.
- [Baidu Tongji](https://tongji.baidu.com/): Web analytics platform for traffic measurement and audience insights.
- [Baidu Marketing](https://e.baidu.com/): Advertising platform for search marketing and promotional campaigns.
- [Baidu Marketing Help Center](https://yingxiao.baidu.com/support/home): Support resources for advertisers using Baidu marketing products.

## Knowledge and Content Products
- [Baidu News](https://news.baidu.com/): News aggregation portal covering current events and trending topics.
- [Baidu Video](https://haokan.baidu.com/): Video platform for short-form and general entertainment content.
- [Baidu Experience](https://jingyan.baidu.com/): How-to knowledge platform with practical tutorials and user guides.
- [Baidu Academic](https://xueshu.baidu.com/): Academic search service for papers, journals, and scholarly resources.
- [Baidu Translation](https://fanyi.baidu.com/): Translation service for text, documents, and multilingual lookup.
- [Baidu Health](https://jiankang.baidu.com/): Health information portal with medical knowledge and service access.

## Support and Corporate
- [Baidu Customer Service Center](https://help.baidu.com/): Central support portal for Baidu products and account-related issues.
- [Baidu Security Center](https://anquan.baidu.com/): Security services and account protection resources for Baidu users.
- [Baidu Privacy Center](https://privacy.baidu.com/): Privacy policies, data handling disclosures, and user privacy information.
- [Baidu Careers](https://talent.baidu.com/): Official careers portal for jobs, internships, and recruitment information.
- [Baidu Investor Relations](https://ir.baidu.com/): Investor relations site with financial reports, filings, and corporate governance.
- [Baidu Research](https://research.baidu.com/): Research organization portal highlighting Baidu AI research and publications.
